subject: ALERT: Microsoft and Google both named among top cloud providers in new research report; AI demand cited
body:
MARKET WIRE ALERTS | Technology | Oct 14, 9:12am ET

Cloud giants lead AI infrastructure race, research firm says

NEW YORK - Amazon, Microsoft and Google continue to dominate the cloud infrastructure market as enterprise demand for AI workloads drives spending, according to a report from a market research firm published this week.

Key points reported:
- The three largest providers together account for roughly two-thirds of global cloud infrastructure spending, a share that has held steady for several quarters.
- Generative AI services were cited as the main growth driver, with enterprise customers expanding commitments.
- Capacity constraints and power availability were described as the main limits to near-term growth.
- Analysts quoted in the report said the figures were consistent with expectations ahead of third-quarter earnings.

The report echoes findings widely covered by other outlets earlier this month and in prior quarters. Shares of the three companies were little changed in premarket trading.
